project.name: Worth Touched Graph Milestone 4 Spatial Geometry Evidence Touch Authority

phases.title: Spatial Evidence Surface Inventory And Deletion Ledger
acceptance: inventory parity test covers every public facade export, ledger constructor, boolean receipt implementation, spatial query adoption row, and kernel workload evidence consumption path
deletion pressure test gives each production bypass row a deletion or cap plan and fails closeout if it remains production-reachable after replacement exists
boundary denial test proves a manual WorkloadEvidenceRow::new row cannot satisfy spatial touch authority even with matching stage, identity, and counters
topology laundering test proves TopologyTouchedGraphBasis and TopologyDeclaredTouchedGraphBasisProof cannot substitute for spatial evidence authority
phases.instructions: Read the Phase 1 section of the spec before planning. Build the typed inventory and deletion ledger first; do not add admission helpers until old authority surfaces are classified. Each row must record source path, exported facade path, authority category, current caller, deletion action, owner, cap, and removal trigger.
phases.qa_focus: Inventory coverage, hard deletion pressure, manual-row denial, topology-laundering denial, public facade reachability, and no residue without owner/cap/removal trigger.

plan.statement: A naive Phase 1 breaks when a single valid boolean receipt for one narrow spatial stage is surrounded by a complete ledger, stage index, topology touched-basis proofs, Query adoption rows, diagnostics, replay/cache residue, and many unrelated rows: any production-reachable path that can promote a raw WorkloadEvidenceRow, copied receipt fields, broad stage scan, topology proof, or local Query inventory row into spatial touch authority makes the future authority product non-exclusive. Quantitatively, the inventory must account for 100% of public facade exports in crates/worth-spatial/src/facade/workload_vocabulary/mod.rs, 100% of evidence-ledger constructors exported or callable through the facade, 100% of BooleanEvidenceReceipt/BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority implementors, 100% of spatial_query_adoption_inventory rows, and 100% of kernel workload evidence consumption methods before any new admission helper is added.
plan.survival_rule: Phase 1 survives by building a typed inventory and deletion ledger first, with source path, exported facade path, authority category, current caller, deletion action, owner, cap, and removal trigger on every row, then by adding parity/deletion/denial/topology-laundering tests that fail closeout on unclassified or still-production-reachable bypasses.

plan.boundary_to_establish: Inventory must distinguish sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt/BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority from public inspection rows and ledgers. WorkloadEvidenceRow::new, WorkloadEvidenceLedger::from_rows, WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct, WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct, and CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger are ledger/inspection/support products, not spatial touch authority.
plan.first_hard_break: Add a new Phase 1 inventory/deletion-ledger surface under worth-spatial that enumerates every workload_vocabulary pub use and each evidence-ledger constructor. The first break is to make any missing export or constructor row fail an inventory parity test rather than allowing a prose-only checklist.
plan.proof_evidence: Focused certification test: inventory parity covers all current workload_vocabulary exports and every public constructor/accessor named in row.rs, ledger.rs, boolean_receipt.rs, and stage_index/product.rs. Structural evidence must cite facade/workload_vocabulary/mod.rs exports and the ledger row count from the typed inventory.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing adapter/shim-like surfaces to classify: WorkloadEvidenceRow::new, WorkloadEvidenceLedger::from_rows, CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger::with_boolean_evidence_receipt, WorkloadEvidenceRow::from_boolean_evidence_receipt, WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct, WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct. Default action is not keep: delete/collapse if they are production admission bypasses; otherwise classify as ledger inspection/support only with cap "cannot satisfy SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority APIs" and compile-fail/denial proof.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: If deleting WorkloadEvidenceRow::new or WorkloadEvidenceLedger::from_rows breaks existing public inspection contracts, classify as capped residue owned by worth-spatial with removal trigger "Phase 2 ordinary admission exists and public inspection no longer needs raw row construction" and require a test proving manual rows cannot satisfy spatial authority.

plan.boundary_to_establish: Phase 1 does not add SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchRequest admission yet. It inventories every current request/receipt lowering path that treats boolean evidence as a workload or operator prerequisite so later phases can replace it with sealed spatial touch authority.
plan.first_hard_break: Inventory all WorthWorkload::require_boolean_* methods and all with_completed_* handoff methods as current caller rows. The break is to fail the plan acceptance if a boolean stage requirement has no deletion/collapse plan or owner.
plan.proof_evidence: Kernel workload evidence consumption path test enumerates require_boolean_declaration_entry through require_boolean_loop_reconstruction_lookup plus complete_boolean_split_handoff and with_completed_boolean_loop_reconstruction, and asserts each appears in the deletion ledger.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing wrappers/bridges: WorthWorkload::require_boolean_* methods, require_boolean_evidence, require_evidence_stage, CompletedBooleanSplitHandoff, CompletedBooleanLoopReconstructionHandoff, OperatorEvidenceBinding::from_ledger. Default plan is to collapse production authority consumption into the future spatial facade proof. Any retained method must be capped as kernel workload evidence consumption only, owned by worth-kernel, with removal trigger "spatial touch authority facade replaces direct ledger lookup" and a test proving it cannot admit authority by itself.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: Query/runtime gap only if the future spatial authority needs a Query descriptor not available until later phases; record as Query gap, not as permission for kernel to keep local authority.

plan.boundary_to_establish: Existing spatial_query_adoption_inventory rows are Query adoption/residue facts only. They cannot be treated as spatial receipt authority, lookup authority, or execution-backed Consumer Kit proof.
plan.first_hard_break: Extend or replace WorthSpatialQueryAdoptionInventoryRow for this phase with deletion-ledger fields: exported facade path, current caller, deletion action, owner, cap, removal trigger. Break tests if the old 7-field row shape is the only inventory for a production row.
plan.proof_evidence: Inventory parity test counts every row returned by spatial_query_adoption_inventory and every mapped spatial row consumed by worth-kernel/src/query_adoption/registry.rs. Deletion pressure test rejects production rows whose replacement_surface is just SPATIAL_QUERY_ADOPTION_RESIDUE_SURFACE without cap/removal trigger.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing local Query ceremony/adapters: boundary_audit, consumer_kit, evidence_reports, residue, support_projection, WorthSpatialQueryAdoptionInventoryRow, current_spatial_* status/counter functions, and kernel spatial_row mapping. Default is collapse into Query Consumer Kit proof in later phases; Phase 1 classifies current local rows as production bypass, certification-only, capped residue, or Query/runtime gap. Retained rows need owner, cap, removal trigger, and proof they cannot satisfy ordinary spatial authority APIs.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: If Query Consumer Kit execution-backed proof is not implemented until Phase 8, mark only Query adoption proof as a named Query/runtime gap; do not allow that gap to keep raw row or local report authority production-reachable.

plan.boundary_to_establish: Denial posture must classify source-substitution/manual rows before support/counter/stage-link issues. Phase 1 inventories existing denial paths and adds hostile tests proving manual row and topology proof substitution are denied before authority exists.
plan.first_hard_break: Add the boundary denial test around a manual WorkloadEvidenceRow::new row with matching WorkloadEvidenceStage, evidence_identity, and counters where possible; expected outcome is a typed manual-row/source-substitution row in the deletion ledger and no spatial authority/admission product.
plan.proof_evidence: Tests: manual row cannot satisfy future spatial authority placeholder/closeout API; current certify_complete and require_boolean_receipt_lookup reject manual boolean stages; denial precedence row records ManualBooleanStage/ManualAuthorityStage as source substitution.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing guard wrappers: WorkloadEvidenceGuard, map_boolean_ledger_error, require_evidence_stage error mapping, stage link validation. Keep only as certification/ledger validation helpers unless collapsed into future SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchDenial. Any mapping retained beside the new denial path must be capped with owner worth-spatial or worth-kernel and removal trigger "SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchDenial replaces ledger-local denial for ordinary authority".
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: If counters cannot be set on public manual rows because WorkloadEvidenceStageCounters constructors are sealed, state that the hostile test uses matching stage/identity and proves manual backing dominates even without counter spoofing; implementation should add an internal certification fixture if exact counter spoofing is needed.

plan.category: derived invalidation, dirty propagation, replay, undo, and transaction scope
plan.boundary_to_establish: Replay/dirty/undo are out of implementation scope for Phase 1, but their current evidence consumers must be inventoried so they cannot later replay from raw rows or topology proof instead of spatial touch authority.
plan.first_hard_break: Do not implement replay helpers. Instead add inventory rows for retained replay and boolean chain handoff consumers that currently read CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger or WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct.
plan.proof_evidence: Structural inventory test asserts every scoped replay/handoff file that imports CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger, WorkloadEvidenceRow, or WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct has a ledger row with deletion action and removal trigger.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing handoff wrappers: BooleanChainIntegrationHandoff, CompletedBooleanSplitHandoff, CompletedBooleanLoopReconstructionHandoff, retained replay workload evidence helpers. Default future action is collapse to products derived from SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority. Retain in Phase 1 only as capped current production callers with cap "cannot construct or substitute spatial touch authority".
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: Full replay/undo proof is deferred by spec to later milestones; classify only as downstream caller inventory here, not as completed replay authority.

plan.category: evidence lookup, indexing, receipts, and ledger identity
plan.boundary_to_establish: Stage index and receipt lookup prove ledger lookup identity, not spatial touch authority. Every BooleanEvidenceReceipt implementor must be inventoried as a possible sealed source for later admission and every lookup product must be marked derived/supporting.
plan.first_hard_break: Inventory all impl BooleanEvidenceReceipt and impl BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority occurrences, including event ledger, segment-pair enumeration, split edge-chain ledger, and loop reconstruction ledger receipts. Break if a receipt implementor is missing or categorized as lookup/adoption instead of sealed receipt source.
plan.proof_evidence: Receipt coverage test compares rg-discovered BooleanEvidenceReceipt/BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority impls against typed inventory rows. Lookup separation test asserts WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct and WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct are classified SpatialLookupProduct/supporting evidence, not SpatialReceiptAdmission.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing conversion helpers: WorkloadEvidenceRow::from_boolean_evidence_receipt, receipt_backing.rs from_*_receipt helpers, WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct::require_boolean_receipt_lookup, CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger::with_boolean_evidence_receipt. Default is collapse ordinary authority to future sealed request admission; retained helpers are capped as ledger row production or lookup support with tests denying authority substitution.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: If deleting receipt_backing helpers would break many existing workload tests before Phase 2, mark capped residue owner worth-spatial, cap each helper to row construction only, removal trigger "all current callers enter SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchRequest", and compile-fail/denial proof that row helpers cannot produce authority.

plan.category: conflict, independence, cache, equivalence, and reuse
plan.boundary_to_establish: Phase 1 only inventories equivalence/reuse identities. It must prevent row count, index identity, local support pins, or topology digest from being planned as substitutes for future spatial touch digest.
plan.first_hard_break: Add deletion-ledger categories for identity-like values: stage_index_identity, WorkloadEvidenceStageLinkSet digest/identity, Query adoption performance counters, OperatorEvidenceBinding identity. Mark them derived/supporting, never admission.
plan.proof_evidence: Structural test validates every identity/counter row has authority_category Derived/Diagnostic/SpatialLookupProduct and a forbidden_substitution field naming lower-authority identity reconstruction.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing wrappers: OperatorEvidenceBinding, WorthSpatialPhaseEightPerformanceCounters, stage index identity strings, stage link identity strings. Keep only as derived diagnostics/counters until replaced; cap "identity cannot promote to authority" with removal trigger "SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchDigest exists and consumers use it".
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: Full conflict/cache/equivalence proof is later milestone work; any implementation attempt in Phase 1 is out of scope unless needed to inventory a current bypass.

plan.category: public facade, diagnostics, counters, and closeout proof
plan.boundary_to_establish: Public facade may aggregate read/inspection exports but must not implement admission behavior. Phase 1 closeout proof is an inventory/deletion report, not a new public authority constructor.
plan.first_hard_break: Create a public-facade inventory parity test that compares workload_vocabulary/mod.rs and facade/query_adoption.rs exports to typed inventory rows. Missing exports fail before implementation can proceed.
plan.proof_evidence: Acceptance tests: inventory parity, deletion pressure, boundary denial, topology laundering. Existing trybuild compile-fail suite must be extended with spatial touch authority fixtures only after Phase 1 inventory names the target surfaces.
plan.adapter_purge: Existing public compatibility-looking surfaces: facade query_adoption re-exports, workload_vocabulary raw row/ledger exports, hidden compile_fail fixtures referencing removed geometry_only_evidence_admission_from_boolean_evidence_receipt. Default is delete stale fixtures/surfaces if replaced; otherwise classify certification-only with proof they do not expose constructors in ordinary builds.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: If a facade export must remain for existing public inspection, owner worth-spatial, cap "read-only or ledger-inspection only", removal trigger "Phase 9 read-only spatial authority status replaces raw facade inspection", and test proving it cannot construct authority.

plan.boundary_to_establish: Deletion ledger is an executable pressure surface: every production bypass row must have deletion action Delete, CollapseToCanonicalProof, CertificationOnly, CappedResidue, or QueryRuntimeGap. Keep is not a valid action.
plan.first_hard_break: Attempt deletion/collapse first for stale geometry-only evidence admission fixture references and production-reachable raw row promotion paths. Where deletion fails mechanically, record exact caller, owner, cap, removal trigger, and proof test.
plan.proof_evidence: Deletion pressure test fails closeout if any Production row has action CappedResidue without owner/cap/removal_trigger, or if any replaced production row remains reachable after a replacement_surface is marked canonical.
plan.adapter_purge: Adapters/shims to name explicitly: geometry_only_evidence_admission_from_boolean_evidence_receipt stale fixture, certification/workload_evidence manual-row generation, platform_storm_subject manual-row mutation, query_adoption residue surface, kernel public API manual ledger fixtures. Default deletion; certification-only retention only when under certification path and unable to satisfy ordinary authority APIs.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: A retained adapter must name whether it is certification-only, capped residue, or Query/runtime gap. The blocker must be mechanical, not convenience: for example "needed to build hostile manual-row fixture until denial API exists" with removal trigger "boundary denial fixture moves to sealed spatial authority denial".

plan.category: compile-fail, hostile tests, line-cap, and composition QA
plan.boundary_to_establish: Tests must prove architecture, not only behavior: manual rows, topology basis/proof, Query descriptors/adoption rows, and public diagnostics cannot satisfy ordinary spatial authority. Phase 1 should keep new code split by inventory rows, deletion actions, topology laundering denial, and public parity rather than adding a broad helper file.
plan.first_hard_break: Add focused test modules with responsibility names, not a milestone bucket: inventory_parity, deletion_pressure, manual_row_denial, topology_laundering_denial. Run line-cap check after edits and split any touched Rust file over 400 lines unless allowlisted.
plan.proof_evidence: Runnable evidence to record in later turns: cargo test -p worth-spatial inventory/deletion/manual/topology tests; cargo test -p worth-kernel workload evidence inventory if kernel rows are added; trybuild compile-fail suite for public constructor fences; line-cap script. Phase 1 plan does not mark QA passed.
plan.adapter_purge: Test helpers are not exempt: any fixture builder, wrapper, bridge, or compatibility facade retained to manufacture rows must live under certification/test_support, be capped, and have a test proving it cannot satisfy ordinary authority APIs. Delete broad or stale fixtures when possible.
plan.blocker_or_cap_rule: If trybuild fixtures cannot be updated before authority types exist, record compile-fail as pending Phase 2/9 surface but still implement runtime/structural denial tests now.

verification.adversarial_constraint: Spatial boolean evidence can be narrow and local inside a large unrelated topology/projection/replay/cache world; a naive implementation breaks if raw WorkloadEvidenceRow values, manual rows, copied receipt fields, broad scans, local Query reports, or topology touched-basis proof can satisfy spatial evidence authority after replacements exist.
verification.mentality_law: MENTALITY.md requires adversarial-constraint-first design and mechanical enforcement over convention; this closeout proves tired-engineer export, replacement-bypass, manual-row, and topology-substitution mistakes trip tests or typed denials.
verification.arch_law: arch_laws.md laws 41 and 42: proof-bearing types must encode what was proven with sealed/private construction, and identity authority cannot be reconstructed from lower-authority representation. Phase 1 preserves that by ledgering raw/public surfaces as collapse/cap/delete targets and denying manual/topology substitutes before authority construction.

phases.title: Admission Contract And Denial Precedence
acceptance: contract parity test proves every ordinary admission path uses sealed receipt plus complete-ledger proof across spatial, kernel, and certification entrypoints
rejection test denies receipt-only, row-only, lookup-only, Query-descriptor-only, topology-proof-only, and schema-vocabulary-only inputs before authority construction
denial precedence test makes source-substitution denials dominate support denials, support denials dominate counter/stage-link denials, and spatial denials dominate Query gaps
diagnostic posture test proves receipt-only preview can expose status but cannot lower to Query, build lookup authority, satisfy replay, or pass closeout
phases.instructions: Read the Phase 2 section of the spec before planning. Freeze the ordinary admission contract in type shape: sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt plus CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger plus stage-index-backed lookup plus support/counter/stage-link proof. Do not make BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority or lookup products alternate constructors.
phases.qa_focus: Single ordinary admission route, no alternate constructors, deterministic denial ordering, diagnostic-only receipt posture, and no Query/topology/schema substitution.

content: Production-scale failure mode: one valid sealed boolean receipt for a narrow spatial stage appears in a complete ledger with unrelated rows, replay/cache diagnostics, topology touched-basis proof, Query adoption inventory, and direct kernel lookup callers. A naive implementation breaks if any ordinary path can construct or imply SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority from receipt-only preview, WorkloadEvidenceRow, BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority, WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct, WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct, Query descriptor/status, topology proof, schema vocabulary, or copied receipt fields.

Quantitative boundary: 100% of ordinary spatial, kernel, and certification admission entrypoints must require sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt + CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger + stage-index-backed receipt lookup + support/counter/stage-link proof. The rejection matrix must cover receipt-only, row-only, lookup-only, Query-descriptor-only, topology-proof-only, and schema-vocabulary-only before construction. Denial precedence must be source substitution > support posture > counter/stage-link > Query gap.

Performance locality: use the complete ledger stage index and lookup products; do not add broad scans after a matching receipt lookup exists except hostile certification baselines. Expose counters for stages and slots touched.

Public facade: facade/workload_vocabulary may export request, status, denial, digest, counters, and read-only authority accessors; it must not export constructors from rows, lookups, Query, topology, schema, or copied fields.

phases.title: Receipt And Ledger Admission
acceptance: replay/equivalence test proves the same sealed boolean receipt admitted through a complete ledger after replay yields the same spatial touch digest, lookup key, stage counters, and support posture
rejection test denies manual rows, unsupported rows, missing authority stages, guard failures, and copied receipt-shaped structs before Query descriptor construction
receipt coverage test admits every current boolean receipt implementor through the ordinary path with the expected BooleanEvidenceStageKind
ledger-locality test proves admission uses the stage index or receipt lookup product rather than scanning the full evidence ledger for every request
phases.instructions: Read the Phase 4 section of the spec before planning. Make sealed boolean receipts and complete ledgers the only ordinary route into spatial touch authority. Admission returns one spatial touch product, not raw rows or mutable ledger references.
phases.qa_focus: Receipt seal, complete-ledger proof, guard/support/stage-link denials, all current receipt implementors, replay determinism, and bounded ledger locality.

plan.adversarial_constraint: A boolean workload may admit N sealed boolean receipts against a complete ledger with M evidence rows after replay. A naive implementation that reconstructs truth from copied receipt fields or scans M rows for each receipt is O(N*M), can select different rows under benign row-order changes, and can promote manual/unsupported/certification-only rows into authority. Phase 4 must make ordinary admission receipt-and-ledger proof-bearing, deterministic across replay/order changes, and bounded to the stage index/receipt lookup product: for one receipt the observable lookup must report exactly one indexed lookup and zero raw-row scans before any Query descriptor is constructed.

relevant_context_read.constraint: Phase 4 requires sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt plus CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger as the only ordinary admission route; denies manual/unsupported/blocked/certification-only/copy-shaped inputs; requires replay/equivalence, coverage, and ledger-locality tests.
Plan starts with the adversarial production constraint, solves proof/locality before facade polish, and requires mechanical enforcement over convention.
Laws 12, 24, 30, 41, and 42 require typed denials, rejection before construction, proof-bearing phase transitions, sealed constructors, and preserved identity authority.
Admission APIs must expose traversal cost and prove bounded locality with counters instead of hiding broad scans.
DX target must make the honest path obvious while exposing the proof boundary and making forbidden routes unrepresentable or visibly denied.
New work must land in single-responsibility modules, avoid broad helper buckets, keep public facades aggregating only, and keep touched files under the 400-line cap unless explicitly exempt.
Query is downstream of admitted spatial touch proof; this phase must deny before Query descriptor construction and must not invent a local pseudo-Query proof lane.
Spatial evidence branch owns sealed boolean/spatial evidence receipts and must not let raw split/loop reconstruction artifacts or topology basis substitute for receipt authority.

Ordinary public facade exports BooleanEvidenceReceipt, BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority, CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger, stage-index products, SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchRequest, authority, denial, counters, and stage vocabulary.
Query adoption rows are inventory/residue/status surfaces only and cannot satisfy spatial evidence authority.

BooleanEvidenceReceipt is sealed; BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority is the stronger row-minting trait; WorkloadEvidenceRow::from_boolean_evidence_receipt is the receipt-backed row constructor; CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger exposes require_boolean_receipt, require_boolean_receipt_lookup, with_boolean_evidence_receipt, and link_required_stages.

Stage offsets provide indexed row lookup; receipt matching currently checks receipt backing, counter equality, identity/type/support, and returns a lookup product with indexed lookup counters and stage-index identity.

Admission already flows through SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchRequest::from_boolean_receipt(...).with_complete_ledger(...).admit(), maps lookup/support/counter/stage-link denials structurally, returns one authority product, and has Phase 3 fake-receipt tests that Phase 4 must extend with real implementor and replay coverage.

Current spatial BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority implementors are PlanarBooleanSegmentPairEnumerationReceipt, PlanarBooleanEventLedgerReceipt, PlanarBooleanSplitEdgeChainLedgerReceipt, and PlanarBooleanLoopReconstructionLedgerReceipt.
WorthWorkload owns a CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger and kernel spatial admission delegates to the spatial request facade; kernel must not reconstruct proof from ledger internals.
Schema exposes shared vocabulary only and topology exposes topology touched basis/query surfaces; neither may become a spatial touch admission source.

directory_skeleton.responsibility: Own sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt and stronger BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority trait boundaries; no public seal or copied-field constructor.
Own WorkloadEvidenceLedger and CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger admission APIs; complete ledger returns receipt lookup/stage-link proof, not raw mutable rows.
Own evidence rows as ledger inputs only; from_boolean_evidence_receipt remains the only ordinary row minting from BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority and must not become a spatial authority constructor.
Own bounded stage-index receipt lookup, counter equality, stable lookup/index identity, and observable zero-scan locality counters.
Own stage-link proof and guard failure preservation for admission; do not collapse into support or generic ledger errors.
Own the single ordinary spatial touch admission route, one proof-bearing authority product, structured denial mapping, and complete BooleanEvidenceStageKind vocabulary.
Add Phase 4 replay/equivalence, rejection, receipt coverage, and ledger-locality tests without bloating existing Phase 2/3 test files.
Provide real event-stage BooleanEvidenceRowAuthority implementors for coverage tests.
Provide real split receipt implementor and replay-equivalence fixture source.
Provide real loop reconstruction receipt implementor for coverage tests without making loop products alternate spatial authority.
Keep kernel as a delegating public route to spatial facade admission, preserving typed denial and never reconstructing proof from internals.
Stay adjacent vocabulary/topology surfaces only; no admission constructors or conversion paths into spatial touch authority.

implicit_requirements: Authority boundary: ordinary admission is exactly sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt plus CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger plus stage-index-backed lookup plus support/counter/stage-link proof; no raw row, lookup product, schema row, topology proof, Query descriptor, raw id/string, or copied receipt fields may construct authority.

Denial posture: manual rows, unsupported/blocked rows, missing authority stages, guard failures, counter mismatches, copied receipt-shaped structs, and stage-link failures deny structurally before Query descriptor construction, preserving receipt/ledger/guard/support/stage-link source.

Deletion/collapse: search scope for adapter/shim/bridge/compat/pass-through routes. Delete or collapse any production-reachable path that admits from raw rows or copied fields; retained compatibility-named test support must be certification/test-only with proof it cannot satisfy ordinary authority APIs.

Performance locality: per receipt admission consumes the stage-index offset/lookup product and exposes lookup counters with one indexed lookup and zero raw-row scans; no per-request full-ledger scan is permitted after index construction.

Public facade: worth_spatial::facade::workload_vocabulary aggregates read-only proof/status and the ordinary request API only; worth_schema names shared vocabulary only; worth_topo topology touched basis remains adjacent and non-substitutable.

Replay/determinism: admitting the same sealed receipt through an equivalent complete ledger after deterministic replay yields identical spatial touch digest, stage-index/lookup key, evidence counters, support posture, and stage-link identity regardless of row order.

Test honesty: Phase 4 tests must exercise real receipt implementors and the public facade/kernel route; fake receipt tests may remain as narrow hostile fixtures but cannot be the only acceptance proof.
Line cap/composition: add a dedicated Phase 4 test module instead of expanding existing broad test files beyond 400 lines; split any touched Rust file over cap unless an explicit exemption exists.

phases.title: Spatial Evidence Lookup Identity
acceptance: lookup equivalence test proves equivalent ledger, stage-index, and receipt inputs produce the same lookup key and product digest with unrelated rows present
boundary denial test rejects wrong boolean stage, wrong evidence identity, wrong stage-index identity, unsupported support posture, and Query descriptor digest substitution
locality counter test proves lookup touched the expected stage-index slots and did not scan unrelated boolean stages
separation test proves lookup products cannot satisfy WORTHQueryGraphTouchDescriptor APIs and Query descriptors cannot satisfy spatial lookup authority APIs
phases.instructions: Read the Phase 5 section of the spec before planning. Separate spatial lookup identity from Query descriptor identity. Derive any new lookup key from admitted spatial authority and stage-index product, never caller strings or raw vectors.
phases.qa_focus: Lookup identity/digest stability, stage-index locality, no broad scans, no Query descriptor substitution, and immutable read-only facade products.

plan.constraint: At production scale, spatial evidence lookup must remain stable and bounded by the single required stage-index slot even when the complete ledger contains many unrelated boolean stages and Query descriptor-shaped digests. A naive implementation that derives lookup from caller strings, raw row vectors, broad receipt scans, or WORTHQueryGraphTouchDescriptor digests can silently admit the wrong evidence or make lookup cost O(total ledger rows/stages) instead of O(required stage slots).
plan.proof_pressure: The implementation must carry typed lookup identity from an admitted spatial touch authority plus the stage-index lookup product, expose counters proving indexed access, and deny every substitution before a lookup product/key is constructed.

context.constrains: Lookup identity must be distinct from Query descriptor identity; any lookup key is derived from admitted spatial authority and stage-index product, never caller strings or raw vectors.
Plan starts from the adversarial failure mode and requires mechanical proof, replay equivalence, and visible cost.
Use typed denial, reject before construction, define explicit equivalence, carry proof through phase transitions, surface counters, seal proof types, and preserve identity authority.
Keep lookup key, denial, digest, tests, and facade aggregation in responsibility-named files under the line cap.
No provenance-named modules, broad helper buckets, or exported internal topology; the tree must show authority boundaries.
Lookup API shape must reveal traversal cost and prove no broad scan through counters. Rejection precedes expensive construction.
The caller experience must make authority and cost visible; invalid stringly/digest shortcuts should be unrepresentable.
Query owns graph touch descriptors and obligation proof; Worth spatial lookup is a separate consumer-side spatial evidence product, not a pseudo-Query descriptor or local Query substitute.
Spatial evidence branch owns lookup key/product after spatial touch authority; loop/split receipts are canonical input evidence and must not be rediscovered.

Current lookup uses stage offsets and returns WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct with private fields, stage identity, support, counters, lookup counters, and stage-index identity, but lacks a distinct spatial lookup key/product digest.
Complete ledgers expose read-only stage index and receipt lookup; spatial touch authority already carries digest, stage link identity, support, counters, and lookup counters.
Public facade currently re-exports the lookup product and spatial touch authority; facade must remain aggregation/status only and not implement admission.
WorthWorkload is the ordinary workload-composition route for completed boolean handoffs; topology facade remains separate Query/topology authority and must not satisfy spatial lookup APIs.
Compile-fail fixtures are automatically discovered under the spatial public facade compile_fail tree.

files.responsibility: Own a sealed SpatialEvidenceLookupKey and optional digest helper if existing WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct cannot carry the full Phase 5 identity cleanly.
Extend the existing lookup product with lookup_key()/product_digest() accessors or a sealed derived product without adding a parallel authority path.
Digest recipe for lookup key/product equivalence over boolean stage, evidence identity, support, counters, lookup counters, stage-index identity, and spatial touch digest.
Typed denial for wrong boolean stage, wrong evidence identity, wrong stage-index identity, unsupported posture, and Query descriptor substitution.
Expose the ordinary derivation method from SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority to spatial lookup product while keeping authority immutable.
Responsibility-named tests for the four Phase 5 acceptance checks; do not grow broad phase or helper buckets.
Public-boundary compile-fail fixtures proving Query descriptors and raw copied fields cannot satisfy spatial lookup authority APIs.
Re-export only read-only proof/status types and no constructors or facade admission logic.

requirements: Authority/proof-bearing types: constructors for lookup key/product stay private or pub(crate); public consumers receive them only through admitted spatial touch authority plus complete ledger/stage-index proof.
Operator/request intent lowering: no new pseudo-Query lane; WorthWorkload completed boolean handoffs remain the ordinary workload-composition proof route when integration coverage is needed.

Query/runtime separation: WORTHQueryGraphTouchDescriptor digest identity must be impossible to pass as spatial lookup authority; separation should be compile-fail where possible and typed denial where runtime hostile input exists.

Validators and denial posture: wrong boolean stage, wrong evidence identity, wrong stage-index identity, unsupported support posture, and Query descriptor digest substitution deny before lookup product construction.

Replay/determinism: equivalent ledgers and replayed receipts with unrelated rows must produce the same lookup key and product digest; benign row-order variation must not affect key identity beyond the existing canonical stage-index digest.

Evidence lookup/indexing: lookup must use WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct::row_for_stage/require_boolean_receipt_lookup and carry WorkloadEvidenceStageLookupCounters showing indexed_lookup_count == 1 and raw_row_scan_count == 0 for one required stage.

Conflict/equivalence/reuse: product digest is the equivalence contract; it must include spatial touch digest and stage-index identity so Query descriptor digests or row-count-only identity cannot collide semantically.
Public facade/diagnostics: facade may aggregate read-only lookup key/product/digest/counter types; it must not expose raw rows, mutable ledgers, constructors, or conversion helpers.

Deletion/collapse: delete any discovered string/digest/raw-row lookup helper or collapse it into certification-only compile-fail proof. No adapter, shim, bridge, wrapper, or compatibility facade may remain as ordinary authority.

Test honesty and composition: runnable tests must use real admitted receipts and complete ledgers with unrelated rows for success paths; hostile row builders are allowed only in boundary-denial fixtures with names that advertise denial/test support.

laws_recorded.perf_laws.md: Performance boundary is named and counter-proven: one indexed stage lookup, zero raw scans.

phases.title: First Downstream Consumer Migration
acceptance: migration parity test proves the migrated workload consumer receives the same receipt identity, support, counters, lookup key, and denial locality as the spatial facade proof product
rejection test proves the migrated consumer rejects manual rows, receipt-only diagnostic posture, raw vectors, Query descriptors, and topology proof before workload evidence treats them as authority
dependency-direction test proves worth-kernel consumes the spatial facade proof and does not reconstruct authority from ledger rows or stage indexes
residue accounting test classifies old caller paths displaced by the first migration as deleted, capped residue, or still pending closeout
phases.instructions: Read the Phase 6 section of the spec before planning. Migrate the smallest real workload consumer that exercises a current boolean receipt implementor and complete ledger with unrelated evidence present. Do not deep-import ledger internals into kernel.
phases.qa_focus: Real production caller, facade-only kernel dependency, rejection parity, residue accounting, and no certification-only migration passed off as production proof.

plan.content: At production scale a completed workload ledger can contain many unrelated evidence rows and multiple boolean receipt families; a naive first migration would let worth-kernel keep reconstructing authority from WorkloadEvidenceRow, WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct, or copied split receipt fields while the new spatial facade proof exists beside it. The phase must survive the concrete bound that the migrated consumer performs exactly one indexed boolean-stage lookup for the consumed receipt, reports raw row scan count 0, preserves the same receipt identity/support/counters/lookup key as SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority::spatial_evidence_lookup, and rejects every lower-authority substitute before downstream workload evidence treats it as authority.

content: Spec lines 801-853: Phase 6 migrates one real downstream spatial evidence consumer before Query lowering; it forbids kernel deep-imports of ledger internals, certification-only proof, and unaccounted deletion of all residue.
_docs/coding_guidelines/MENTALITY.md: requires adversarial-constraint-first design, mechanical enforcement, architecture tests, visible cost counters, and authority-first derivation.

_docs/coding_guidelines/arch_laws.md: laws 11, 12, 24, 30, 41, and 42 constrain this phase to proof-bearing types, typed denials, rejection before construction, and identity preservation rather than reconstruction.
_docs/coding_guidelines/perf_laws.md: requires lookup cost to be visible at the named boundary and forbids cheap-looking broad scans or repeated rediscovery.
_docs/coding_guidelines/dx_laws.md: requires public DX to expose proof phase progression, typed failure topology, and boundary cost rather than hiding authority transitions.

_docs/coding_guidelines/composition_laws.md and domain_structure_laws.md: require responsibility-named files/tests, no broad buckets, no milestone/provenance modules, facade aggregation only, and import graph proof for dependency direction.

crates/worth-query/docs/AI_README.md and authoring/graph-obligation-consumer-kit.md: Query descriptors are not local authority; downstream proof should use public proof lanes and must not hand-roll local reports/adapters.

_docs/worth/touched-graph-roadmap.md: Milestone 4 spatial branch requires sealed boolean/spatial receipts -> spatial touch authority -> lookup products, with raw rows and broad stage scans forbidden substitutes.
_docs/worth/milestone-7.4.md: loop/split downstream consumers must consume receipt-backed ledgers and may not reopen raw fragment, continuation, or stage folklore.

No new broad bucket module named migration/phase6/helpers. If the migrated consumer proof grows beyond one responsibility, create responsibility-named child files such as downstream_split_consumption/spatial_authority_input.rs or spatial_touch_downstream_split_consumption_tests.rs.

Authority boundary: the migrated kernel consumer must consume SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority and SpatialEvidenceLookupProduct from worth_spatial::facade::workload_vocabulary, not WorkloadEvidenceRow, raw vectors, copied receipt fields, topology proof, Query descriptors, or direct stage-index authority.

Denial posture: manual rows, receipt-only diagnostic posture, raw vectors/ids/strings, Query descriptors, topology proof, unsupported support posture, and foreign/missing spatial lookup identity must deny before PlanarBooleanDownstreamSplitConsumption is constructed.

Dependency direction: worth-kernel may call the public spatial facade and WorthWorkload::admit_spatial_geometry_evidence_touch; it must not deep-import crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/evidence_ledger internals or reconstruct lookup identity from stage-index fields.

Deletion/collapse: first attempt to delete the downstream split input's direct WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct authority parameter. If a legacy direct stage-index route remains for certification or later loop closeout, classify it with owner WorthKernel/WorthSpatial, cap, removal trigger, and a test proving it cannot satisfy ordinary migrated authority.

Performance locality: migrated product must preserve the Phase 5 lookup counters: required_stage_count 1, indexed_lookup_count 1, raw_row_scan_count 0, rejected_raw_row_scan_count 0 even with unrelated evidence rows present.
Public facade behavior: facade files aggregate read-only proof/status only; any new admission logic belongs in the owned kernel handoff or spatial downstream consumption module, not in facade mod.rs.

Replay/determinism: migration parity must compare migrated consumer fields against the spatial facade proof product for the same completed split handoff and with unrelated evidence present; replay changes must preserve receipt identity, lookup key, product digest, support, and counters where the existing split replay subject is available.

Test honesty: tests must execute a real CompletedBooleanSplitHandoff through workload composition. Helper-local row builders are acceptable only for hostile denial fixtures, never as migration parity proof.
Line-cap/composition: touched Rust files and tests stay under 400 lines unless already exempt; broad public-contract support files should be split by responsibility before adding more assertions.

content.category: authority/proof-bearing types and sealed constructors
content.plan: Start with CompletedBooleanSplitHandoff because it is the smallest real workload consumer that exercises PlanarBooleanSplitEdgeChainLedgerReceipt and a complete ledger. Change downstream split consumption input so ordinary construction requires a spatial touch authority plus spatial lookup product derived from the completed workload. This establishes the proof boundary that receipt-only and stage-index-only values cannot enter. Adapter purge: delete the direct stage-index authority constructor first; if a private constructor is needed for hostile tests, keep it pub(crate) under a denial/test-only responsibility and prove it cannot satisfy public admission. Proof: migration parity test compares migrated product to facade authority/lookup fields.

content.category: operator/request intent lowering
content.plan: Do not add new operator semantics. The only intent lowering in scope is the existing split handoff lowering into downstream split consumption. Rename or add methods so the call site states spatial touch admission explicitly, then route current admit_downstream_split_consumption through that path. Adapter purge: remove any pass-through method that preserves the old stage-index route unless it is classified in residue accounting. Proof: grep-based dependency-direction test plus compile errors at old direct constructor callers.

content.category: Query or runtime selection/admission
content.plan: Do not lower to WORTHQueryGraphTouchDescriptor in Phase 6. Add explicit hostile tests showing Query descriptors and Query descriptor digests can only produce substitution denials and cannot satisfy the migrated split consumer. Adapter purge: no Query-to-spatial lookup bridge, no descriptor digest accepted as lookup key. Proof: rejection test calls existing deny_query_descriptor_digest_as_spatial_evidence_lookup_authority / SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchRejectedInput::query_descriptor and asserts migrated consumer denial locality.

content.category: validators, invariants, and denial posture
content.plan: Map missing/foreign spatial authority, unsupported support posture, wrong receipt identity, wrong lookup key/stage-index identity, manual row, raw vector, topology proof, and receipt-only diagnostic posture into typed PlanarBooleanDownstreamSplitConsumptionDenialKind variants or typed WorkloadCompositionError::SpatialTouchAuthority propagation before product construction. Adapter purge: no string matching over denial detail; existing human_reason stays presentation only. Proof: rejection tests cover every required denial and assert no product exists.

content.category: derived invalidation, dirty propagation, replay, undo, and transaction scope
content.plan: No invalidation/undo expansion in this phase. Preserve replay identity by comparing the migrated split consumer against the spatial facade proof product for the same completed split handoff and, where existing fixtures expose replayed split handoffs, compare original/replayed lookup keys and product digests. Adapter purge: do not introduce replay-only split fixtures as authority. Proof: migration parity test includes retained replay subject if available; otherwise record exact blocker and limit replay to existing Phase 4 proof while migration tests remain production-handoff based.

content.category: evidence lookup, indexing, receipts, and ledger identity
content.plan: Consume SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority::spatial_evidence_lookup on the complete ledger, then store/read lookup key, support, stage counters, lookup counters, and spatial product digest on downstream split consumption. The old stage-index row count can remain diagnostic only if not used as authority. Adapter purge: remove WorkloadEvidenceBooleanReceiptLookupProduct and WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct from the migrated consumer's public input path. Proof: locality counter test asserts required_stage_count 1, indexed_lookup_count 1, raw_row_scan_count 0, and no unrelated boolean stage scan.

content.category: conflict, independence, cache, equivalence, and reuse
content.plan: No cache/conflict product is introduced. Preserve equivalence by deriving the migrated product identity from the spatial lookup product digest and the existing split downstream receipts rather than from row count or caller strings. Adapter purge: no cached lookup key builder in kernel. Proof: parity test with unrelated evidence rows present yields same lookup key/product digest as facade proof.

content.category: public facade, diagnostics, counters, and closeout proof
content.plan: Expose only read-only accessors on the migrated downstream consumption product for spatial lookup key, product digest, support, counters, lookup counters, and denial locality. Keep worth_spatial::facade::workload_vocabulary as aggregation only. Adapter purge: no facade-side builder or compatibility facade. Proof: public contract test uses the ordinary exported types and asserts facade parity; source audit confirms facade mod.rs has no logic.

content.category: hard deletion/collapse of replaced surfaces
content.plan: First hard break: remove the direct WorkloadEvidenceStageIndexProduct parameter from PlanarBooleanDownstreamSplitConsumptionInput::from_split_ledger_receipt and clean every caller. Then update spatial_evidence_surface_deletion_ledger kernel rows so the displaced split downstream path is explicitly deleted/collapsed or capped. Adapter purge: if old require_boolean_split_lookup remains for other non-migrated consumers, classify it as pending closeout with owner, cap, and removal trigger rather than treating it as migrated. Proof: residue accounting test inspects deletion ledger rows and asserts no unclassified old caller path.

plan: 1. Adversarial constraint. Phase 7 breaks at production scale if a narrow spatial receipt inside a complete ledger with unrelated evidence can be lowered into Query by copying digest strings, raw ledger rows, topology touched-basis proof, or a previously lowered Query descriptor. The implementation must keep lowering breadth bounded to one admitted SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority and its derived lookup/operating-world facts: zero broad ledger scans, zero Worth-local selector dialects, and zero descriptor-to-authority promotion paths. Descriptors are derived Query artifacts only; they can be destroyed and rebuilt from spatial authority, but they cannot rebuild spatial authority.

2. Relevant context read. Inspected spec Phase 7 lines 855-926: lower admitted spatial touch authority into Query graph touch vocabulary, create typed Query gap rows, do not perform Milestone 5 selection. Inspected MENTALITY.md rules 1, 3, 6, 7, 9, and 10: adversarial constraint first, mechanical enforcement, architecture tests, visible counters, authority before derivation, one canonical artifact. Inspected arch_laws.md laws 12, 24, 30, 33, 41, and 42: typed denials, rejection before construction, proof-bearing phase outputs, derived state separation, sealed proof types, identity authority preservation. Inspected perf_laws.md: descriptor lowering must preserve semantic-delta bounded work and expose cost/counter posture. Inspected composition_laws.md and domain_structure_laws.md: query lowering must be a narrow responsibility, not a phase bucket or facade implementation. Inspected _docs/coding_guidelines/dx_laws.md: the caller surface must expose the authority-to-derived boundary and make invalid actions unrepresentable. Inspected WORTH Query docs AI_README.md and graph-obligation-consumer-kit.md: use Query public facade/Consumer Kit surfaces, do not invent local pseudo-Query proof. Inspected worth-query descriptor/selector APIs: facade::exports_runtime.rs exports WORTHQueryGraphTouchDescriptor, WORTHQueryGraphTouchReadVerb, WORTHQueryGraphReadTouchShape, WORTHQueryGraphTouchSelector, and WORTHQueryGraphObligationOperatingWorldDescriptor; descriptor.rs exposes read_family, read_family_shape, live_read, live_read_shape, declared_mutation_collection; touch_selector.rs exposes collection, relation_kind, aspect_path, read_verb, declared_mutation_collection matching. Inspected worth-spatial facade/query_adoption.rs and workload_vocabulary/mod.rs: current facade aggregates evidence authority and Query adoption inventory but must not implement lowering logic. Inspected spatial_touch_admission authority.rs, lookup.rs, operating_world.rs, and mod.rs: admitted authority and lookup products already carry digest, stage, support, counters, stage-index identity, and current-head operating-world posture that lowering must consume.

4. Directory skeleton. Add `crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/evidence_ledger/spatial_touch_admission/query_lowering.rs` for the derived `SpatialEvidenceQueryTouchDescriptor` product, digest, counters, and constructor from `SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority` plus `SpatialEvidenceLookupProduct`. Add `query_lowering_denial.rs` only if denials would push the product file toward mixed responsibilities; otherwise keep a small typed denial in `query_lowering.rs`. Add `query_gap.rs` for `SpatialEvidenceQueryGapRow` with owner, cap, blocker, and removal trigger. Add responsibility-named tests under the same module: `query_descriptor_parity_tests.rs`, `query_descriptor_denial_tests.rs`, `query_selector_precision_tests.rs`, `query_gap_tests.rs`, and `query_milestone_boundary_tests.rs`. Update `spatial_touch_admission/mod.rs` and `evidence_ledger/mod.rs` only as aggregation surfaces. Update `crates/worth-spatial/src/facade/query_adoption.rs` only to re-export the ordinary public lowering function/types; do not put lowering logic in the facade. Touch worth-query files only if public exports are missing or descriptor expressiveness has a real Query-owned gap; otherwise consume existing Query facade exports.

5. Implicit requirements made explicit. Authority boundary: lowering consumes `SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority` and, where lookup identity is needed, `SpatialEvidenceLookupProduct`; raw rows, copied receipts, topology touched-basis proofs, Query descriptors, lookup keys alone, digest strings, and schema vocabulary cannot call the constructor. Denial posture: classify substitution before Query expressiveness gaps, and preserve typed denial/gap rows rather than strings. Performance locality: descriptor lowering must derive from the already admitted authority and lookup product, not scan the ledger or stage index; any counters should report descriptors emitted and gaps emitted, not broad evidence scans. Public facade behavior: expose read-only derived products and gap rows through `worth_spatial::facade::query_adoption`; do not expose constructors that can mint authority or accept lower-authority substitutes. Replay/determinism: same admitted authority across replay/public facade paths must yield identical Query descriptor digest, operating-world descriptor digest, selector rows, and gap digest ordering. Selector precision: collection, relation-kind, aspect-path, read-verb, and declared-mutation selectors must match only descriptors the spatial product declares; if spatial evidence cannot honestly express a selector through Query, emit a gap. Milestone boundary: Phase 7 may produce descriptor lowering and gap posture only; it must not register, select, execute, or close Milestone 5 obligations. Test honesty: include public-boundary or integration paths from real admitted spatial authority; helper-only descriptor construction is insufficient.

6. Phase-local implementation sequence. First hard proof: create the query lowering product with private fields and constructor reachable only from admitted spatial authority plus lookup product; derive Query descriptor with `WORTHQueryGraphTouchDescriptor::read_family_shape` for read-family spatial evidence and map `SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchOperatingWorld::CurrentHead` to `WORTHQueryGraphObligationOperatingWorldDescriptor::any_committed_authority`. First hard break/deletion attempt: search for any Worth-local descriptor/selector helper or raw digest lowering path under `worth-spatial/src/query_adoption*`; delete or collapse it into the new product, or classify it as a typed Query gap if Query cannot express it. Then implement typed `SpatialEvidenceQueryGapRow` for unexpressed facts with owner=`WorthSpatial`, cap, blocker, and removal trigger. Then add selector precision tests that construct selectors from Query public APIs and assert exact positive/negative matches against the lowered descriptor. Then add denial tests that prove raw rows, copied receipt-shaped structs, topology touched-basis proofs, and existing Query descriptors cannot enter the lowering path; use compile-fail where possible and typed substitution denials where runtime examples are required. Then add descriptor parity tests over replay/public facade admission paths and compare spatial touch digest, lookup product digest, descriptor digest, and operating-world digest. Then add milestone-boundary tests that assert no Consumer Kit adoption proof, selected obligation set, or execution-backed proof is claimed by the Phase 7 product. Finally run `cargo check -p worth-spatial -p worth-query`, targeted worth-spatial Phase 7 tests, targeted worth-query selector tests if touched, and line-cap checks for touched Rust files.

findings.summary: spatial_local_ceremony_audit certifies a synthetic one-line source string instead of the real worth-spatial local ceremony surfaces.
findings.details: Phase 8 requires Consumer Kit adoption proof from a local ceremony audit and hard-break proof that local report structs, local digest strings, support row lists, source greps, and fabricated Query receipts are deleted or capped. The implementation builds WORTHQueryBoundaryAuditSourceSet::new("worth-spatial").source("worth-spatial-query-adoption", "pub fn worth_spatial_uses_query_consumer_kit_execution_authority() {}") at lines 298-303. That audit can never detect a reintroduced local report, source grep, support list, or fabricated receipt in crates/worth-spatial/src/query_adoption.rs or its child modules. The test at crates/worth-spatial/src/query_adoption/consumer_kit/tests.rs:25 only asserts evaluated_source_count() == 1, so it proves the synthetic fixture was audited rather than the public/source boundary.
findings.contradicted_claim: Consumer Kit ownership and local ceremony audit are mechanically proven for worth-spatial production sources.
findings.required_repair: Build the local ceremony audit from the real scoped source files that could contain local Query ceremony, or classify any source not auditable as capped residue with owner/cap/removal trigger. Strengthen the test to fail if the audit source labels do not cover the real worth-spatial query_adoption/facade surfaces or if seeded local ceremony in those real sources would be invisible.

The repaired test local_ceremony_audit_detects_seeded_bypass_in_real_source_scope builds seeded_source with the forbidden WORTHQueryGraphObligationIndex::from_catalog call before QUERY_ADOPTION_RS at lines 210-212. A forbidden pattern inserted after ordinary lifetime-heavy declarations in the real source can be masked, so the test does not prove seeded local ceremony in those real sources would be visible.

Worth must not build pseudo-Query layers, local digest helpers, source-grep proof, or fabricated Query receipts; execution-backed adoption uses Query Consumer Kit public proof.

plan.content: At production scale, one kernel boolean workload can carry a narrow spatial evidence receipt through a complete ledger that also contains unrelated topology, replay, diagnostics, cached products, and later-stage boolean evidence. Phase 10 fails if any cross-crate caller can reconstruct the Milestone 4 handoff from raw WorkloadEvidenceRow values, broad stage scans, topology touched-basis proofs, local Query support/adoption rows, type-name guards, or stale roadmap prose instead of consuming the admitted worth_spatial facade products. The hard closeout must compare exactly four replay-stable handoff identities across original and replayed execution: spatial authority digest, spatial evidence lookup key, Query descriptor digest, and Consumer Kit adoption proof/adoption manifest digest; and it must reject five reintroduced residue families: raw-row, broad-stage-scan, topology-laundering, local Query support, and type-name guard paths.

content: Authority boundary: only a sealed BooleanEvidenceReceipt plus CompleteWorkloadEvidenceLedger may produce SpatialGeometryEvidenceTouchAuthority; kernel must call WorthWorkload::admit_spatial_geometry_evidence_touch and spatial facade lowering APIs.

Denial cases: raw WorkloadEvidenceRow values, broad-stage-scan lookup, copied receipt fields, topology touched-basis proofs, Query descriptors/digests, local Query support rows, and type-name guards must either fail compile-fail/certification or remain explicit capped residue that cannot satisfy ordinary authority APIs.

Deletion/collapse: obsolete projection/admission/type-name/local Query support surfaces are attempted as hard deletions first; retained surfaces need owner, cap, removal trigger, and a test proving production-unreachability.

Performance locality: replay and closeout must compare digest-bearing authority/lookup/descriptor/adoption products and visible counters; no production proof may rely on a broad source/ledger scan except certification-only source audits.

Public facade behavior: facade files aggregate read-only status/proof products and denial helpers only; admission behavior stays in the sealed workload/evidence ledger modules and kernel consumes through the facade.

Replay/determinism: original and replayed kernel boolean workloads must preserve spatial authority digest, lookup key identity, Query descriptor digest, Consumer Kit adoption proof/adoption manifest digest, support posture, and relevant counters.
Test honesty: certification must exercise real cross-crate public boundaries and real workload evidence subjects, not helper-only synthetic rows or fixture-only string scans.

Roadmap/documentation: docs are updated only after behavior is certified and must not claim Milestone 5 Query selection, Milestones 6-8 graph-read access adoption, Milestone 11 broad evidence lookup, or 7.5 overlap extraction.
